Container.Name: MediaHub
Container.Overview: Self-hosted, mobile-first monitoring dashboard for Emby, Sonarr, Radarr and InfiniDysk. See what's playing, what's downloading and what needs attention, and optionally link a trusted second MediaHub read-only.
Container.Requires: To show InfiniDysk health, cache metrics and live streams, put MediaHub on the same custom Docker network as InfiniDysk (Network Type: your custom network) and pin FRONTEND_BACKEND_API_KEY in InfiniDysk's template.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the MediaHub web interface.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Database, encryption key and cache. Back this folder up: without secret.key the stored API keys can't be decrypted.

Config.Name: Server name
Config.Description: Display name for this server on first start (e.g. Skynet). Editable later in Settings.

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: auto: secure when the request arrives over HTTPS. Use true behind an HTTPS reverse proxy or tailscale serve.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: Comma-separated IPs whose X-Forwarded-For/Proto headers are trusted (your reverse proxy).

Config.Name: Demo mode
Config.Description: Show generated sample data (for trying out the UI).
